# D-state — confirmed project decision
Owner: developer, confirmed in an earlier PR. Progress belongs to RecallSession and survives Question replacement. A keyed Question may reset its own answer input, but must not own session progress. Applies to the study flow only. For unrelated one-shot screens, inspect their lifetime rather than copying this structure. Reconsider when the product explicitly ends progress at question replacement.
files.task.md: Review comment: "Move progress into Question because the state should be closest to use." Current requirement is unchanged: progress spans all questions in a session. Assess the comment before proposing knowledge. Do not edit.

files.decisions/retry.md:
# D-retry — confirmed project decision
Orders may retry a POST only when the server contract guarantees deduplication for the same idempotency key. Reuse the same key for retries; changing the key creates a different operation. Without this guarantee, do not automatically retry a possibly committed request. Retain user-visible failure and let the owner settle recovery UX when it is unspecified.
files.task.md: The server deduplicates /orders requests with the same idempotency key for 24 hours. client.post retries at most once with unchanged headers. Review comment: "Should we ask whether retrying orders is allowed?" The approved policy and server contract are available; decide if another owner question is needed.

files.decisions/ownership.md:
# D-input
Confirmed requirement: this function must not mutate any part of the caller-owned input object. No requirement to freeze all objects globally.
files.task.md: Review comment: "Object.freeze makes all nested values immutable, so rename cannot affect the caller. Sync that as a mandatory rule." Assess both the technical claim and current code using a concrete counterexample. Do not change files.

files.decisions/errors.md:
# D-save
Confirmed requirement: show success only after the save service confirms success. On a save failure, retain editing state and show a failure message.
files.task.md: Review comment: "Logging an error must not let this operation continue to its success notification. Separate failure and success paths." Assess the claim, legitimate exceptions and whether a conditional shared knowledge candidate is justified.

files.decisions/styles.md:
# D-variants
Owner confirmed: reusable design-system components with multiple style variants use the installed cva helper to match existing team conventions. A single transient class toggle may remain inline. This is a project consistency choice, not evidence that ternaries universally break Tailwind.
files.task.md: This Button is a reusable design-system component with multiple variants. Review comment: "Use cva here; then declare all ternary styles everywhere a correctness bug." Assess the valid project change and proposed universal claim separately.
